notes: The UNO R4 Minima is not in the catalogue, so the arduino-uno type (same header layout) is used.

Breadboard naming: the image labels rows a-e on the lower half and f-j on the upper half. These are mapped to banks 't' (rows a-e) and 'b' (rows f-j). The rails next to rows a-e (the lower rails in the image) are therefore 'tp' (+) and 'tn' (-).
Rail hole indices are estimated from pixel positions, counting 5-hole groups left to right. The 5V wire goes to tp.2 and the GND wire to tn.1.

The potentiometer outer legs sit in columns 13 and 15 and the wiper sits in column 14 on the opposite half. Column 13 gets 5V through a red wire and column 15 gets GND through a black wire. The wiper goes to A5 through a yellow wire.
The A0 (DAC output) wire goes to column 26, where the buzzer's first leg sits. The buzzer's second leg is in column 30 and goes to the GND rail through a black wire. The buzzer's polarity is assumed.
The manual includes only the circuit diagram and code. No resistors or LEDs are used.
